# Operating a board

## `config.php`

Generated by the installer
(`phpbb/install/module/install_filesystem/task/create_config_file.php`). The
exact set of keys it writes:

```php
<?php
// phpBB 3.3.x auto-generated configuration file
// Do not change anything in this file!
$dbms = 'phpbb\\db\\driver\\mysqli';
$dbhost = 'localhost';
$dbport = '';
$dbname = 'phpbb';
$dbuser = 'phpbb';
$dbpasswd = '…';
$table_prefix = 'phpbb_';
$phpbb_adm_relative_path = 'adm/';
$acm_type = 'phpbb\\cache\\driver\\file';

@define('PHPBB_INSTALLED', true);
@define('PHPBB_ENVIRONMENT', 'production');
```

| Key | Notes |
|---|---|
| `$dbms` | a **driver class name**, not `mysql`. One of the classes in `phpbb/db/driver/`. |
| `$table_prefix` | the real prefix. Never assume `phpbb_`. |
| `$phpbb_adm_relative_path` | rename `adm/` and change this to obscure the ACP |
| `$acm_type` | cache driver class: `file`, `apcu`, `memcached`, `redis`, `wincache`, `memory`, `dummy` (see `phpbb/cache/driver/`) |
| `PHPBB_INSTALLED` | absent or false sends every request to the installer |
| `PHPBB_ENVIRONMENT` | `production`, `development` or `test` — see below |

The comment says do not change anything; in practice `$acm_type`,
`PHPBB_ENVIRONMENT` and the database credentials are edited by hand routinely.
Keep `config.php` out of backups that leave the server, and out of version
control.

## Environments

`config/` holds `default/`, `production/` and `installer/`. `PHPBB_ENVIRONMENT`
picks which container configuration loads.

- **`production`** — everything cached, generic error pages.
- **`development`** — templates recompile on every request, real error messages,
  the debug toolbar. **Use this while developing a style or an extension**; the
  cache-purge-after-every-edit cycle mostly disappears.

Never leave a public board in `development`: it leaks paths and query details.

## The cache

Lives in `cache/` (plus whatever `$acm_type` uses). It holds the compiled
container, compiled templates, the compiled text formatter, the config array
and query results.

**Purge after changing any of these:**

| Changed | Why |
|---|---|
| a template or a stylesheet | compiled templates are cached |
| a language file | cached |
| `config/*/services*.yml` or an extension's `services.yml` | the container is compiled |
| a BBCode, a smiley, the censor list | the text formatter is compiled |
| extension code | container and autoloader |
| `phpbb_config` via SQL | the config array is cached — use `config:set` instead |

```
php bin/phpbbcli.php cache:purge
```

Deleting `cache/*` by hand works but can leave files owned by the wrong user.
Prefer the command, run as the web server user.

## Cron

Two modes:

1. **Web-triggered** (default) — a hidden image on page loads runs due tasks.
   Simple, but ties task duration to a visitor's request and does nothing on a
   quiet board.
2. **System cron** — set `config['use_system_cron']` and schedule:
   ```
   */5 * * * * cd /path/to/phpbb && php bin/phpbbcli.php cron:run
   ```
   Correct for any board with real traffic. Run it as the web server user.

`cron:list` shows the tasks and whether each is due. Tasks include pruning,
session garbage collection, search index maintenance, queued email and
attachment orphan cleanup.

## Permissions

The model is in the **phpbb-data** skill's pitfalls reference; operationally:

- **Roles** are named bundles. Change a role and every group using it changes.
  Prefer editing a role over setting individual permissions.
- **Group permissions** are the normal lever. Per-user permissions exist but
  make a board unmaintainable — use them only for genuine exceptions.
- **Three settings**: YES, NO, NEVER. **NEVER wins over YES from any other
  source.** Use NEVER only when you really mean "no matter what group they are
  in"; a stray NEVER is the usual cause of "this user cannot see the forum and
  I cannot work out why".
- **Global vs forum** — `a_` and `u_` permissions are global, `f_` and `m_` are
  per forum.
- ACP → *Permissions* has copy tools: copy a forum's permissions to others, copy
  a user's to another. Use them rather than clicking through each forum.
- Permissions are cached in `users.user_permissions`. The ACP clears it; code
  that writes ACL rows must call `$auth->acl_clear_prefetch()`.

To diagnose, use ACP → *Permissions → View permissions*, which shows the
effective result and where each setting came from.

## Search

Backends in `phpbb/search/`:

| Backend | Notes |
|---|---|
| `fulltext_native` | phpBB's own index in `phpbb_search_wordlist` / `_wordmatch`. Default. Portable, gets slow on large boards. |
| `fulltext_mysql` | MySQL fulltext indexes. Faster, MySQL only. |
| `fulltext_postgres` | PostgreSQL fulltext. |
| `fulltext_sphinx` | Sphinx. Fastest for large boards, needs a separate daemon. See `docs/sphinx.sample.conf`. |

**Switching backend requires a full reindex** from ACP → *Maintenance → Search
index*. On a large board this is long; the ACP does it in batches. Delete the
old index first to reclaim space.

Symptoms of a stale index: recent posts not found, deleted posts still in
results. Reindex.

## Attachments

- Files live in `files/`, named by `physical_filename` — random names, and the
  directory must not be web-browsable. `real_filename` is what the user sees.
- Allowed types are ACP → *Attachments*, backed by `phpbb_extension_groups` and
  `phpbb_extensions`. **Nothing to do with board extensions.**
- After changing the thumbnail size: `php bin/phpbbcli.php thumbnail:recreate`.
- Orphaned attachments (`is_orphan = 1`) are uploads whose post was never
  submitted; a cron task cleans them.
- `files/`, `store/`, `cache/` and `images/avatars/upload/` must be writable by
  the web server. Wrong ownership here is the most common post-migration
  breakage.

## Installing and updating

- The installer is `install/`. **Remove or rename it after installing** — phpBB
  refuses to run normally while it is present with `PHPBB_INSTALLED` unset.
- Update by replacing the files, then visiting `install/` or running
  `db:migrate`. Extensions and styles are not touched, but an extension built
  for an older release may need updating.
- `php bin/phpbbcli.php update:check` reports available updates, and
  `update:check vendor/package` does the same for one extension.
- Order that works: back up → disable extensions → replace files →
  `db:migrate` → `cache:purge` → re-enable extensions one at a time.

## Web server configuration

Sample configs ship in `docs/`:

- `docs/nginx.sample.conf`
- `docs/lighttpd.sample.conf`
- `docs/sphinx.sample.conf`

Apache is covered by the bundled `.htaccess`. The critical part of any of them
is denying web access to `config.php`, `cache/`, `files/`, `store/`,
`includes/`, `phpbb/` and `vendor/`. A default Nginx configuration serves all of
those — do not skip the sample.

## Backups

A complete backup is:

| | |
|---|---|
| the database | all 69 tables |
| `config.php` | credentials and prefix |
| `files/` | attachments — **not in the database** |
| `images/` | uploaded avatars, custom smilies, ranks |
| `store/` | generated files |
| `ext/` | installed extensions |
| `styles/` | installed styles |

`cache/` is disposable. A database-only backup silently loses every attachment
and avatar — the most common backup mistake on a phpBB board.

The ACP has a database backup tool; for anything large use `mysqldump` or the
equivalent directly.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | First thing to try |
|---|---|
| A change to a template, CSS, language file or service did nothing | `cache:purge` |
| Blank page or generic error after an extension update | `php bin/phpbbcli.php --safe-mode extension:show`, then disable the culprit |
| Forums missing from the index or nested wrongly | `fixup:fix-left-right-ids` |
| A user cannot see something and their groups look right | look for a NEVER; ACP → *View permissions* |
| Search misses recent posts | reindex |
| New BBCode works in new posts only | `reparser:reparse` |
| Cannot log in as founder | `user:add` from the CLI to create a new one |
| "General error" with no detail | set `PHPBB_ENVIRONMENT` to `development` temporarily, reproduce, set it back |
| Uploads fail | ownership and permissions on `files/`, `store/`, `images/avatars/upload/` |

The board's own error log is ACP → *Maintenance → Error log*, backed by
`phpbb_log` with `log_type` for errors. PHP-level failures land in the web
server's log instead.
